title: Protection of Wages on Insolvency Ordinance
verified_how: Browser pane: https://www.elegislation.gov.hk/hk/cap380. Title 'Cap. 380 Protection of Wages on Insolvency Ordinance'. Short title matches. Current version dated 01/05/2025.
notes: Protection of Wages on Insolvency Fund pays arrears of wages, wages in lieu of notice and severance pay when the employer is insolvent.
